title: Owner event
description: Something that happened to an owner of an Obysphere (sphere-api.md section 3.2): readable by every member, so an agent can say why an owner's key changed. kind is open: a client ignores an event whose kind it doesn't know.

id.description: Increases with each event in this Obysphere; GET .../owner-events?after= reads from it.

kind.description: rebound: the owner bound a new key with a sign-in. Open: later additions add kinds.

account_linked.description: rebound: true when this sign-in's account was linked to the owner by this event (the owner had none).

revoked.description: The owner's agents this event revoked.
